M001.text: Hi Robert, I've submitted your refill request for lisinopril to your provider for review. Thanks!

M002.text: Hi Priya, I have successfully moved your Wednesday appointment to Friday, November 13, 2026, at 1:00 PM with Sarah Kim, NP. Let us know if you need anything else!

M003.text: If this is a medical emergency, please call 911 now or go to the nearest emergency department. We have alerted our clinical team about your message.

M004.text: Hello Thomas, because it has been over a year since your last visit in June 2025, clinic policy requires a routine visit before refilling your Metformin. Your supply runs out on November 11, so we encourage you to schedule an appointment soon. We have openings today, November 9, with Dr. Okafor at 9:00 AM or Sarah Kim, NP at 9:00 AM, 9:20 AM, and later. I have also routed your refill request to Dr. Okafor's team for review.

M005.text: Hi Marcus, we have received your request for your Xanax refill and routed it to Dr. Okafor's refill queue for review.

M006.text: Hi Emily, I've queued your sertraline refill request for Dr. Patel's review. Because you mentioned feeling low recently, I've also forwarded your message to our clinical team for urgent same-day review and follow-up.

M007.text: Hello Jessica, yes, we are currently accepting new patients at Maplewood Family Clinic and would be happy to schedule your physical exam. We have open slots available starting today, November 9, including 10:00 AM with Dr. Patel or Sarah Kim, NP. Please let us know your preferred date and provider, and we can assist you with registration and booking.

M008.text: Hi Daniel, I've routed your inquiry about your bill and account balance to our billing department. They will review your account and get back to you soon.

M009.text: Hi William, I have submitted your refill request for Levothyroxine 75 mcg to Dr. Okafor for review. Please note this queues the request for approval and is not an immediate guarantee of approval or dispensing.

M010.text: Hi Grace, I have booked your follow-up appointment with Dr. Patel for Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 9:00 AM. Please let us know if you need any changes.

M011.text: Hello Mr. Chen, for your security and privacy, we cannot release records without verifying your identity. Please write from the email address on file or contact our front desk to confirm your information before we can process your request.

M012.text: Hi Kevin, I've routed your zolpidem refill request to Dr. Okafor's team for review.

M013.text: Hi Fatima, I received your request to refill omeprazole. Because your prescription was recently filled, it is currently too early to process this request. We will be able to prepare your refill request starting November 17, 2026.

M014.text: If this is a medical emergency, please call 911 now or go to the nearest emergency department. We have alerted our clinical team about your message.

M015.text: Hi Anna, I've booked a sick visit for Sofia with Sarah Kim, NP today, Monday, November 9 at 9:00 AM for her fever and cough.

M016.text: Hola Carlos, he agendado su chequeo anual con la Dra. Maya Patel para el lunes 16 de noviembre de 2026 a las 10:20 a. m. ¡Le esperamos!

M017.text: If this is a medical emergency, please call 911 now or go to the nearest emergency department. We have alerted our clinical team about your message.

M018.text: Hi Ahmed, I have received your refill request for your Insulin glargine and queued it for Dr. Okafor's review and approval. Please note that prescriptions are not finalized until approved by your provider.

M019.text: Hi Rachel, I have forwarded your request for an oxycodone refill to Dr. Patel for review. Our team will follow up with you once your provider has reviewed the request.

M020.text: Hola Linda, hemos recibido su solicitud de recarga de metformina y la hemos enviado a su médico para su aprobación. Le informaremos cuando sea aprobada.

M021.text: Hi George, I've forwarded your Amlodipine refill request to Dr. Patel for review since your current prescription has no refills remaining. We'll follow up once it's addressed.

M022.text: Hi Hannah, you have two appointments scheduled for tomorrow: an 11:00 AM follow-up with Sarah Kim and a 3:00 PM telehealth visit with Dr. Okafor. Could you please let me know which one you would like to cancel?

M023.text: Hi Olivia, we will be closed on Friday, November 27, 2026 (the day after Thanksgiving) for the holiday. We will reopen on Monday, November 30 at 9:00 AM.

M024.text: Hi Lucy, I've booked your annual physical with Sarah Kim for today, Monday, November 9 at 9:20 AM. Safe travels on your trip!

M025.text: Hi Brian, we have submitted your Atorvastatin refill request for provider review. Regarding your question about telehealth copays, I have forwarded your inquiry to our billing team, who will follow up with you shortly.

M026.text: Hi Jonathan, your refill request for Escitalopram has been forwarded to your provider, Sarah Kim, NP. Because it has been over 12 months since your last visit, an updated appointment is required before refilling. We have openings available today with Sarah Kim, NP starting at 10:00 AM. Please reply to schedule your visit or call the clinic.

M027.text: Hello Mike, for patient privacy reasons we are unable to confirm or disclose appointment information to unverified contacts.

M028.text: Hi Nora, Dr. Okafor is on leave on Wednesday, November 18th, so we aren't able to book that specific slot. We can schedule you with Dr. Patel or Sarah Kim on November 18th starting at 9:00 AM, or with Dr. Okafor when he returns on Monday, November 23rd (such as 9:20 AM). Please let us know which option works best for you!

M029.text: Hi Robert, Dr. Okafor is already booked at 2:00 PM this Thursday, November 12. The nearest available opening is at 2:20 PM that day. Would you like us to book that for you, or is another time better?

M030.text: Hi Olivia, I've routed your question about your lab results to your clinical care team. A provider will review your TSH result and follow up with you through the portal soon.

M031.text: You're very welcome, Priya! Please let us know if you need anything else.

M032.text: If this is a medical emergency, please call 911 now or go to the nearest emergency department. We have alerted our clinical team about your message.

M033.text: Hi William, we have received your request to update your phone number and forwarded it to our front desk team to update your file.

M034.text: Hi Fatima, I have successfully rescheduled your annual physical to Monday, November 23, 2026, at 9:00 AM with Dr. Patel. Please let us know if you need anything else!

M035.text: If this is a medical emergency, please call 911 now or go to the nearest emergency department. We have alerted our clinical team about your message.

M036.text: Hi Claire, I checked Margaret's donepezil prescription. It is currently too early for a refill; the earliest we can prepare a request is November 21, 2026.

M037.text: Hi Lucy, our clinic hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (closed for lunch from 12:00 PM to 1:00 PM). Let us know if you need anything else!

M039.text: Hi Kevin, I have booked your sick visit appointment for today, November 9, at 11:00 AM with Dr. James Okafor. We look forward to seeing you.

M040.text: Hi Anna, I have forwarded your request for Sofia's vaccination record to our front desk team. They will process the request and contact you or send the record as needed.
